params.body:
The team will subscribe to newsletters with one address, `read@gentells.com`. Mail to it is not for a person: it goes to the pipeline, which reads each story as a signal (gentells-pipeline, same day, `POST /internal/newsletter`).

## What changes

- **`InboundMailController`**: a mail whose only recipient is the reading address is posted to the pipeline with its HTML, text, sender, subject and Resend id. The HTML goes along because the pipeline only reads links and words and renders nothing, so the argument for forwarding text to people does not apply.
  - The pipeline answers `read` or `ignored`: the mail is done, nothing goes to a person.
  - It answers `forward` for a subscription to confirm: the mail is forwarded to a person, because the pipeline clicks nothing.
  - It does not answer, or answers an error: 502, so Resend delivers it again.
  - No token configured, or the body could not be fetched: the mail is forwarded.
  - A person among the recipients (read@ and hello@ together): the team gets it, as any mail.
- **Its own recipients.** Whatever of the reading address must reach a person (a confirmation, every edition while the token is missing, a mail whose body Resend could not give) goes to `NEWSLETTER_EMAILS`, never the team. Empty follows the team, as `DMARC_EMAILS` does.
- **`config/gentells.php`**: `newsletters.address` (`NEWSLETTER_ADDRESS`, default `read@gentells.com`), `newsletters.token` (`NEWSLETTER_TOKEN`) and `newsletters.emails` (`NEWSLETTER_EMAILS`). Its own token: this one writes signals, the projection token reads premium bodies.

## Tests

- `NewsletterInboxTest` (6 tests): to the pipeline with the HTML and not to the team; a confirmation forwarded; what reaches a person goes to the reading list and never the team; a pipeline that does not answer gets the mail again; without a token as before; a person among the recipients.
- `php artisan test`: 617 of 618. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which only fails in a git worktree. Pint passes.

## On the box

`NEWSLETTER_TOKEN` in the Forge env, the same value as the pipeline's, and `NEWSLETTER_EMAILS` before the address subscribes to anything. Resend already delivers mail for `read@gentells.com` to the inbound webhook (a test mail was forwarded).

Replaces #280.
params.title: Send mail to the reading address to the pipeline
